newsitem.title: DENMARK: Tele Danmark expands cable TV operation.
newsitem.headline: Tele Danmark expands cable TV operation.

text.p: Danish Telecom group Tele Danmark said on Friday that it was expanding its cable television operation with the acquisition of 35,000 subscribers from MultiChoice Danmark.
A Tele Danmark statement said that MultiChoice Danmark, owned by France's Canal Plus, was the leading local supplier of coded cable programmes.

Taking over the MultiChoice subscribers, the statement said, would facilitate the introduction of Tele Danmark's analog decoders and further the 51 percent state-owned group's strategy of combining tv content and distribution.
Tele Danmark, which currently has about 750,000 cable subscribers, would not disclose the terms of the deal.
Last November the former state monopoly, in partnership with Norway's Schibsted, bought Danish company Metronome's film, music and video production business.
